summary: This note describes how the Major League Baseball season schedule is structured. Each of the 30 teams plays 162 regular-season games, 2,430 games in total, over about six months, followed by the postseason. It explains the season's start and end dates, the limit of 20 postseason games for a wild-card team that goes the distance, and how the regular season is built from series of three or four games, with mid-week and weekend series.
one_line: Overview of the MLB season structure: 162 games per team, opening day timing, postseason limits, and how series are scheduled.
key_facts: The MLB season schedule consists of 162 games for each of the 30 teams in the American League and National League.
The total number of regular-season MLB games is 2,430.
The regular season typically runs from early April to late September, followed by the postseason in October.
As of 2018, the MLB season runs 26 1/2 weeks through the last Sunday of September or first Sunday of October.
One or more International Opener games may be scheduled outside the United States before the official Opening Day.
A team can play a maximum of 20 postseason games in a year if it is a wild card and advances to each series going the distance.
A Division Series going the distance is 5 games; a League Championship Series or World Series going the distance is 7 games.
Pairs of teams are never scheduled to play single games against each other, except to make up a postponed game.
Most regular-season series are of three or four games, though two-game series are also scheduled.
Teams play one mid-week series and one weekend series per week.
Mid-week series games are usually scheduled between Monday and Thursday, while weekend games are scheduled between Thursday and Monday.
Beginning in 2018, teams start and end their season on a weekend for a total of 26 1/2 weeks.
Due to the mid-week all-star break in July, teams are scheduled to play 27 weekend series and 25 mid-week series, for a total of 52 series.
The 52 series comprise 24 divisional series, 20 inter-divisional series, and 8 inter-league series.
A team's road games are usually grouped into a multi-series road trip, and home series are grouped into homestands.
